rule: A 'record' claim must state the peak it beats and its date (e.g. 2026 high of $126.41 on Apr 30). Check it against the node's own facts.
Utilities trade on rates and AI power demand, not oil. Check the period and do not call them an oil winner.
Risk parity means equalizing risk contribution across asset classes. It is not a word for concentration risk.
Sector and breadth claims must name the period. September and October 2026 had opposite leadership.
Weekly sector returns differ by proxy (XLK vs S&P 500 IT index). Name the proxy and use one consistently.
